name: Tulsi Adrak Kadha
subtitle: the warm one: holy basil and ginger, simmered rather than blended

ingredients.note: dried tulsi works at half the quantity
stirred in off the heat, not into boiling liquid

steps.text: Bring 300ml water to the boil with the ginger and peppercorns.
Lower the heat and simmer ten minutes, until the water has taken colour and reduced by about a third.
Take off the heat, add the tulsi leaves and cover. Leave five minutes.
Strain into two cups. Stir in the honey and lemon once it has stopped steaming hard.

storage: Best fresh. It will reheat once without much loss.

provenance.note: Kadha is the household decoction of north India, boiled up at the first sign of a cold and made differently in every family. Tulsi grows in courtyards across the country and is the one ingredient almost every version shares.
